description: Operator-editable symbolic math rules for Weslr. Defines allowed functions, variable limits, and known equations of interest. All new rules require operator approval.

equations_of_interest.name: Arrhenius equation
equations_of_interest.description: Temperature dependence of reaction rate k. A = pre-exponential factor, Ea = activation energy (eV), R = Boltzmann constant, T = temperature (K).

equations_of_interest.name: Shockley-Queisser efficiency limit
equations_of_interest.description: Detailed-balance limit for single-junction photovoltaic cells. T_cell and T_sun in K (typically 300 K and 6000 K).

equations_of_interest.name: Kesterite efficiency model
equations_of_interest.description: Empirical temperature correction for kesterite solar cell efficiency. eta_0 = reference efficiency, T_ref = reference temperature.

equations_of_interest.name: Drug concentration decay
equations_of_interest.description: First-order elimination of drug concentration C over time t. k = elimination rate constant.

equations_of_interest.name: Michaelis-Menten kinetics
equations_of_interest.description: Enzyme reaction velocity v as function of substrate concentration S. Vmax = maximum velocity, Km = Michaelis constant.

equations_of_interest.name: Beer-Lambert law
equations_of_interest.description: Absorbance A of a solution. epsilon = molar absorptivity, c = concentration, l = path length.

equations_of_interest.name: Nernst equation
equations_of_interest.description: Electrode potential E. E0 = standard potential, n = electrons transferred, F = Faraday constant.
